display_name: The Hundred and Fifty Soldier Martyrs

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Εκατόν πενήντα Μάρτυρες Στρατιώτες», with the rank word left off. The page names none of the hundred and fifty.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 ноября ст. ст. — «Мч. Азы и с ним 150-ти воинов (284-305).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (2 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Εκατόν πενήντα Μάρτυρες Στρατιώτες»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2905/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The company is not enumerated — the page names not one of the hundred and fifty — so it is one folder. It is not the corpus's `hundred-and-fifty-martyrs-of-palestine`, who are not soldiers and are kept on another day. No year, no place, no hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).

floruit.note: This folder held no date at all. days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 19 ноября ст. ст. with «(284-305)» and its life page puts the martyrdom «при императоре Диоклитиане (284 - 305)». The reign is kept as the interval; no year inside it is chosen.
